title: Preparation of Tissue Sections for Proteomic Analysis
author: Jamie Allen
materials: Samples are now ready to for LCMS analysis.

steps.title: Initial Tissue Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare tissue cryosections in Eppendorf tubes by adding lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL to 500 µL of lysis buffer to the tissue.

steps.title: Sample Thawing and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Thaw and sonicate the samples to ensure complete lysis.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes in dry ice for 00:05:00.
Defrost tubes on wet ice for 00:05:00 and vortex briefly.
Create an icy slurry by adding ice to water in the sonicator.
Sonicate samples in the ice bath for 00:10:00 and vortex.

steps.title: Clarification of Lysate
steps.instruction: Separate the soluble protein from the cellular debris.

substeps.instruction: Spin tubes in a microcentrifuge for 00:05:00 at 14,000 rpm.
Pipet the supernatant into a new labeled Eppendorf tube and discard the pelleted tissue.

steps.title: Protein Quantification
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration using the Pierce BCA Protein Assay kit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare BSA standard curve with lysis buffer per kit instructions.
Pipette 25 µL of standards into 'curve' wells of a clear flat bottom plate.
Pipette 20 µL of lysis buffer into sample wells.
Pipette 5 µL of sample into each sample well and mix 5x.
Prepare working reagent per BCA protocol and add 200 µL to each curve/sample well.
Incubate samples for 00:30:00 at 37 °C.
Set Softmax Pro template with 5x dilution for samples during incubation.
Read plate at 562 nm absorbance.
Export results to BCA excel workbook to calculate the volume required for 100 µg of protein.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins using an acetone/methanol mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µg of protein sample to a 1.5 mL labeled Eppendorf tube.
Add lysis buffer to the sample to reach a total volume of 100 µL.
Add 300 µL ice cold 75:25 acetone:methanol.
Vortex sample and incubate for 02:00:00 at -80 °C (alternatively, incubate overnight at -20 °C).
Place tube rotor in a cold centrifuge at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pellet Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the protein pellet and remove residual solvents.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from freezer and centrifuge for 00:15:00 at 4000 RPM; keep on ice or cold block after centrifugation.
Add 300 µL of ice cold acetone to all samples and spin for 00:15:00 at 4000 RPM.
Remove and discard supernatant.
Allow residual acetone to evaporate at room temperature briefly (only until TFE and Tris are ready); do not over-dry.

steps.title: Reagent Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the alkylating agent and digestion enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 0.5M IAA: Dilute 1 vial of pre-weighed IAA with 100 µL of Rapid Trypsin Digestion Buffer (store in a dark drawer).
Prepare Promega Rapid Trypsin: Add 100 µL of Promega Resuspension Buffer to 1 bottle of rapid trypsin.

steps.title: Protein Resuspension and Digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and perform enzymatic digestion.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the 100 µg pellet in 10 µL of neat TFE and 10 µL of 100 mM Tris (pH 8.0) and vortex to dissolve.
Add 4 µL of prepared 1 µg/µL Rapid Trypsin to each sample (1:25 enzyme:protein ratio).
Gently vortex each sample.
Incubate plate at 55 °C for 00:45:00.
Remove samples from incubator and pulse in centrifuge to remove condensation from the cap.
Add 5 µL 60% Formic Acid to each sample to stop digestion.

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Store digested samples until ready for desalting.

substeps.instruction: Place samples on ice or store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Tip Preparation and Conditioning
steps.instruction: Prepare and condition the Evotips for desalting.

substeps.instruction: Place 100 µL of 1-propanol into the wells of a 96 well plate with MTP adaptor (only in wells to be used).
Prepare tip rack with the required amount for digested and QC samples.
Add 20 µL of Solvent B to each tip.
Centrifuge Evotips box at 700 x g for 00:01:00.
Place Evotip adaptor rack on the MTP plate with 1-propanol and soak for 00:01:00; ensure tips are pale white.

steps.title: Tip Equilibration
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the tips with Solvent A.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL of Solvent A to each tip.
Centrifuge Evotips box at 700 x g for 00:01:00.

steps.title: Sample Loading
steps.instruction: Load the digested samples or controls onto the tips.

substeps.instruction: Add sample or control to each tip for a total of 20 µL (500 ng of digested sample or 100 ng of HeLa digest).
Centrifuge Evotips box at 700 x g for 00:01:00.

steps.title: Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Perform on-tip reduction and alkylation of the peptides.

substeps.instruction: Reduce samples by adding 1 µL premade TCEP (0.5 M) and incubate at room temperature for 00:30:00.
Alkylate samples by adding 2 µL of 0.5 M IAA and incubate in a dark drawer at room temperature for 00:30:00.

steps.title: Final Wash and Preservation
steps.instruction: Wash the tips and preserve the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 73 µL of Rapid Trypsin Buffer to each sample.
Add 20 µL of Solvent A to each tip and centrifuge at 700 x g for 00:01:00.
Add 100 µL of Solvent A to each tip and pulse centrifuge at 700 x g for 00:00:10 to keep tips wet.
